recipes.name: Lights opposite the screen
recipes.description: Shows the opposite hue of the screen, so a green screen gives red lights. Greys and blacks have no hue and stay as they are.
recipes.pasteInto: the Screen colors graph, then wire it between Sample zones and Ease

recipes.name: Loudness switch
recipes.description: Two looks that swap when the music gets loud. A small band around the threshold stops the lights flickering between them.

recipes.name: Bass, mids and treble as RGB
recipes.description: Bass drives red, mids green and treble blue, added together, so the room's color follows the balance of the music.

recipes.name: VU meter fill
recipes.description: A bar of color fills across the room with the music's level. Turn the bar size down for a single dot that slides along instead.
recipes.layout: Fills along your zone layout, so the result depends on where your lights sit

recipes.name: Beat-stepped chase
recipes.description: A rainbow across the room that steps forward on every beat and holds still between them.
recipes.layout: Spreads across your zone layout, so the result depends on where your lights sit

recipes.name: Candles
recipes.description: Warm, flickering candle light that needs no input. Each light flickers on its own.
recipes.layout: Each zone flickers on its own, so the look depends on how many zones you have

recipes.name: Audio color over the screen
recipes.description: The screen's colors with a drifting audio color layered on top. The louder the music, the more of it shows.
